summary: Cases on j: j = 0 by definition; otherwise both spaces are signed spaces with the same signs.

steps.claim: j = 0: both sides agree by definition.
j = j′ + 1: both are signed spaces with the same signs (block-diagonal signs), equal after reindexing (signedSpace_eq_reindex).
steps.lean:
exact signedSpace_eq_reindex _
    (Units.ext ((fromBlocks_diagonal ..).trans (by simp; congr with ⟨⟩ <;> rfl)))
